title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 41: City life (Set 2)

lessons.title: nhúng từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm City life (Set 2) ngay nhé!


Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm City life (Set 2)
vocabTable.example: Write suitable words to complete the conversation. Grace: How do you usually get to work? Jake: I usually take 15.1 because it’s fast and goes through tunnels below ground, so I don’t have to worry about traffic. Grace: Lucky you! I drive by car because I’m not close to any station. And I often get stuck in traffic, especially on the streets with a lot of 15.2 . Jake: Why don't you try another public transport? Grace: I’ve tried taking the 15.3 before, but it takes too long since I have to change lines several times. Jake: Well, I heard there will be a new 15.4 line that is close to your house. It builds above the streets so it might be faster. You should try it! Grace: Thanks! I’ll definitely try it once it’s available.

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm City life (Set 2)
vocabTable.example: Read the following passage and choose the option that best fits each blank. City life can be exciting but also challenging. One of the biggest problems is 16.1 adventure congestion pollution entertainment . The streets are very crowded with many vehicles, so it is hard for people to get around. Although 16.2 global warming community service public transport social media  is a convenient option, there are still delays in the rush hour. I often rely on the bus line near my home, but sometimes it is late, especially in the morning. Another issue in the city is 16.3 hygiene fragrance cost population . The water and air are polluted. Public places can sometimes be dirty. Some areas even look 16.4 cozy attractive ugly scary , with old buildings and a lack of green space. Living in the city can also be 16.5 habitable expensive affordable economical , with high prices for housing and everyday goods. However, living in the city also means having easy access to many shops, restaurants, and services, which can make life more convenient. Despite the challenges, city life offers many opportunities and excitement for those who enjoy it.
